verification.summary: Aligned the Go client with upstream codex app-server-client's non-blocking event invariant: every Client epoch owns a fresh event pump, and unsupported Phase 1 server requests are explicitly rejected instead of filling an unread bounded queue and hiding later RPC responses.

verification.summary: Race tests flooded 100 unsupported server requests ahead of a foreground response and replaced Client epochs repeatedly; RPC response delivery and new-epoch notifications remained live. The full codex-remote race suite and six relevant go-bridge tests passed repeatedly.
